scope.method: Source review and independent arithmetic from existing canonical development JSONL and analysis JSON/CSV. Existing archive-integrity results inspected; geometry derivation was not rerun.

edit_audit.canonical_attempt_policy: First terminal outcome; all four current edit stages contain only successful terminal rows and no duplicate attempts.
edit_audit.same_policy_reference_check: All record reference paths match task declarations; all best-single and feature-selector reference canonical IDs match the declared preeditTrial. All three warm actions have identical reference, edited-reference and protection-state context per case/edit.
edit_audit.guard_rule: Only named cold proposals; raw invalid and current source valid triggers current-source effective output. Same candidate-policy pre-edit reference is retained. Serial estimate includes raw plus fallback operation time. No warm guard is credited.
edit_audit.global_reflow_penalty_check: All 81 valid requested-global-reflow records have stable_score equal to score_balanced, with both movement and side-churn penalties omitted and raw measurements retained.

bootstrap.unit: whole base diagram; eligibility applied within the five-edit bundle
bootstrap.paired_validity: Failed/invalid outcomes remain in validity and time contrasts. Soft and movement contrasts require both outcomes valid; no invalid result becomes a zero cost.

color_controls.note: Geometry equality and hard validity are separate. The 96 records include duplicated raw/guarded cold views; only 72 distinct color outcomes were executed.

direction_and_applicability.caveat: projectScene retains the layout-tool default for source recipes without a root engine. The setting mismatch count is not source direction-compliance. Endpoint-center progress includes cycles, returns and hidden descendants and is diagnostic only.
direction_and_applicability.presentation_03: Current source direction=down fit=wide preserves earlier node geometry. Separate also preserves old nodes despite a DOWN invocation setting. Its apparent one-job raw hard-validity rescue does not prove the requested direction task was satisfied.
direction_and_applicability.recommendation: Preserve the global-reflow exclusion and resolve direction-versus-format precedence before claiming independent direction and format controls.

existing_archive_audit.scope: geometry signatures, not whole archive bytes

edit_audit.preedit_guard_observation_note: No pre-edit or post-edit guard fallback was observed in the reviewed development sample only. No heldout guard observation is made.

context_audit.canonical_attempt_policy: First terminal row per trial; no later success promotion.

source_and_box_checks.note: Existing checks inspected; this review did not execute geometry comparisons.

joint.caveat: Do not replace the 60 total-job denominator with 55 feasible jobs, or describe the 39/60 default-inclusive diagnostic triple as the selected nine-combination result.

warm_native.input_contract: Unperturbed native drawings; no patchDoc, history=true, scope=all, warmStart=true. Retain-current is an identity alternative and receives no extra execution credit.
warm_native.caveat: 60/60 acceptable means within the practical bands, not identical to the full oracle and not proof of local-edit stability.

network.applicability: Raw cold engine screen: warmStart=false, settle=true, maxIterations=640. Stable-edit profile is excluded.

targeted_supplement.caveat: Supported-input supplementary probes do not erase the original unsupported-scope or unavailable-input outcomes.

reporting_recommendations: Count 360 actual edit outcomes plus 12 shared-state preparations; do not count 480 derived views as 480 executions.
State that no pre-edit or post-edit cold guard fallback was triggered in this development sample only; fallback behavior is supported by the declared code rule rather than an observed E rescue.
Keep projected direction settings and endpoint-center diagnostics separate from intent compliance.
Use the applicable warm comparison: all three policies have 45/49 hard-valid jobs after global-reflow diagnostics are excluded.
Distinguish practical-band coverage from exact equality or universal engine dispensability.
Keep the selected nine joint alternatives separate from the default-inclusive twelve-configuration diagnostic.

resolved_issues.finding: Context and joint proposal outputs are written before the final archive-integrity check. A future mismatch could leave newly written unverified outputs after the analyzer exits with failure.
resolved_issues.current_impact: Resolved; current context archive audit verifies 440 canonical geometry signatures with zero mismatches.
resolved_issues.recommendation: Verify canonical archives before publishing final analysis/proposal outputs, or write temporary outputs and replace final files only after verification succeeds.
resolved_issues.resolution: Canonical successful output and input references are now collected and verified before any summary or proposal writer runs. References include direct-current joint comparisons, raw network inputs and targeted input references outside the profile pools.

patch_followup.scope: Narrow inspection of the archive-publication ordering/reference coverage and ordinary-edit reporting patches; the full audit and bootstrap were not rerun.
patch_followup.ordinary_validity_report: Completion table explicitly separates all jobs including color from ordinary valid/attempted jobs.
patch_followup.prior_708_paired_fields: Original audit result retained. This follow-up reviewed the added ordinary counts and reporting; it did not rerun the original 708 checks.
